unitIdeas.title: Fractions as Relationships
unitIdeas.understanding: Fractions show a relationship between the numerator and the denominator. Fractions are equivalent if they show equal amounts of the same whole.

unitIdeas.title: Unit Fraction Models
unitIdeas.understanding: You can use unit fraction models to compare fractions.

unitIdeas.title: Measuring
unitIdeas.understanding: You can use line plots to show and compare measurement data.

unitIdeas.title: Number Flexibility to 100 for All Four Operations
unitIdeas.understanding: You can add, subtract, multiply, and divide to solve problems about time, liquid volume, and mass.

unitIdeas.title: Measuring
unitIdeas.understanding: Both estimates and exact measurements can be used to solve problems about liquid volume and mass.

unitIdeas.title: Analyze Quadrilaterals
unitIdeas.understanding: Attributes like sides and angles can be used to describe, analyze, classify, and compare quadrilaterals.

unitIdeas.title: Fractions of Shape and Time
unitIdeas.understanding: Fractions can describe the area of a shape that has been broken into equal parts.
